about.title: Meet Austin Jose
paragraphs: Austin is a full-stack engineer who thinks in systems, not just interfaces. At Zolvit (formerly Vakilsearch), he builds and maintains high-traffic Next.js applications supported by reliable backend services, where performance and architecture directly influence production reliability.

His approach focuses on understanding the why behind technical decisions. From designing server-side rendering strategies to structuring APIs and managing efficient data flows between services, the goal is to build solutions that scale with both users and teams.

Beyond building features, Austin engineers systems that prioritize maintainability and long-term stability. Modular frontend architectures, clean backend integrations, and well-structured data workflows ensure platforms remain reliable as products continue to evolve.

highlights.title: Performance Engineering
highlights.description: Obsessed with Core Web Vitals, JS execution optimization, and delivering sub-second experiences.

highlights.title: Architecture Decisions
highlights.description: SSR vs SSG vs ISR—choosing the right rendering strategy for each use case.

highlights.title: End-to-End Ownership
highlights.description: From technical specs to production deployment, owning the complete development lifecycle.

highlights.title: Cross-Team Collaboration
highlights.description: Working with backend, design, and product teams to ship cohesive solutions.

highlights: Engineered and maintained high-traffic Next.js applications powering a large-scale legal services platform.
Led performance optimization initiatives, improving Core Web Vitals through JavaScript execution tuning, advanced caching strategies, and optimized asset delivery pipelines.
Designed and implemented CMS-driven page architectures, enabling non-engineering teams to create and manage dynamic content independently.
Diagnosed and resolved large-scale indexing and rendering issues across 3,000+ pages, improving platform stability and search crawler efficiency.
Implemented structured data systems and metadata pipelines, improving content discoverability and increasing platform visibility within days.
Developed production-ready React and Next.js components for landing pages & product
Part of building a shared UI boilerplate including reusable components and common imports to standardize development across the codebase
Integrated RESTful APIs with structured state management, error handling, and loading states
Documented and maintained reusable components in Storybook to improve developer experience and component discoverability
Collaborated with backend and design teams to deliver features and improve cross-team development workflows

projects.title: Case Studies
projects.description: Real production systems with measurable outcomes. Each project represents a problem solved, not just code written.

items.title: SEO-Optimized Landing Pages with Headless CMS
items.problem: Marketing teams required frequent landing page launches but depended on engineers for every update, slowing campaign execution.
decisions: Static Site Generation (SSG) in Next.js for fast load times and SEO performance
Headless CMS with Strapi to allow marketing teams to manage page content independently
Reusable UI components documented with Storybook
CloudFront + S3 CDN distribution for global content delivery
ElasticSearch integration for dynamic search capabilities
items.impact: Enabled marketing teams to launch and update landing pages independently, reducing engineering dependency and improving page performance.

items.title: Product Onboarding & Payment Flow System
items.problem: Users dropped off between lead submission, payment, and product onboarding due to fragmented flows and slow page loads.
decisions: Server Side Rendering (SSR) to ensure dynamic product onboarding pages load with fresh user data
Next.js API routes for handling backend orchestration and payment callbacks
Integrated Razorpay and PayU payment gateways
ElasticSearch for lead and transaction indexing
items.impact: Improved onboarding conversion by providing a seamless transition from lead submission to payment and product access.

items.title: Zenius AI Compliance Chatbot
items.problem: Users struggled to navigate complex compliance processes and required faster access to contextual guidance within the platform.
decisions: Real-time WebSocket communication for low-latency chat interactions
Next.js based frontend for embedding chatbot seamlessly inside product workflows
Structured UI components to present compliance guidance and AI responses
items.impact: Simplified compliance workflows and improved user engagement with instant AI-driven assistance inside the platform.

items.title: Real-Time Video Consultation Platform
items.problem: Users needed a reliable platform for live consultations with professionals while maintaining low latency and session stability.
decisions: WebRTC peer-to-peer communication for real-time video streaming
Integrated authentication and session lifecycle management
items.impact: Enabled seamless video consultations with stable connections and real-time communication between users and professionals.

items.title: Lawyers Listing & Public Legal Q&A Platform
items.problem: Handling large datasets of lawyers and legal queries while maintaining fast search and SEO visibility.
decisions: Server-rendered pages for optimal search engine indexing
Elasticsearch for high-speed search across thousands of records
JWT-based authentication and role-based access control
items.impact: Delivered sub-100ms search responses while serving high volumes of legal queries with reliable uptime.

items.label: Underperforming Pages Fixed
items.description: Reduced poor-performing pages to zero in Google Search Console through systematic technical SEO improvements.

items.label: Search Impressions Increase
items.description: Achieved measurable SEO lift within 10 days through structured data and meta tag optimizations.

items.label: Core Web Vitals Green
items.description: Optimized LCP, FID, and CLS across mobile and desktop for production applications.

items.label: Application Uptime
items.description: Maintained high availability for legal services platform serving thousands of daily users.
